summary: Technical Support Professional skilled at resolving complex customer service issues, troubleshooting technical problems, and driving productivity in fast‑paced environments.

experience.title: Project Manager
responsibilities: Built and maintained relationships with service providers, dealers, and consumers.
Provided base‑level IT support to company personnel.
Defined project deliverables, monitored task status, and delivered status reports to stakeholders.
Collaborated with cross‑functional teams to draft project schedules and plans.
Monitored costs, timescales, and resources to achieve project goals.
Managed a team of 40 members, enforcing deadlines and ensuring project quality.
Partnered with various departments to address operational issues.
Planned, implemented, and managed project contracts, scheduling, risk analysis, and quality control.

experience.title: Information Technology Specialist
responsibilities: Trained new employees and explained protocols clearly and efficiently.
Researched and resolved issues on computer systems and databases.
Managed and supported workstations on TCP/IP, VPN, Wi‑Fi, and Active Directory.
Supported Avaya PBX telephone systems and integrated new technologies such as cloud printing.
Performed routine maintenance and upgrades on servers, workstations, copiers, and printers.
Acted as liaison to resolve technical issues for vendors, managers, and end users.
Developed and maintained support documentation, including troubleshooting steps and installation instructions.
